fullPassage: Patients should be aware that experts often disagree about who should be treated for various conditions. For example, expert committees in Europe and the United States set different guidelines about when to treat high blood pressure. The group of American experts believed that for mild elevation of blood pressure the benefits exceeded the risks from treatment. They wrote guidelines suggesting that patients with mild blood pressure elevation take medicine. But in Europe, an expert committee with access to the same scientific data set different guidelines that don't advise treatment for mild elevation of blood pressure. In Europe, people with the same symptoms would not be encouraged to take medicine. Different groups of experts can disagree significantly about what is "best practice."

questions.passage: Patients should be (A)[aware / ignorant] that experts often disagree about who should be treated for various conditions. For example, expert committees in Europe and the United States set (B)[different / identical] guidelines about when to treat high blood pressure. The group of American experts believed that for (C)[mild / severe] elevation of blood pressure the benefits exceeded the risks from treatment. They wrote guidelines suggesting that patients with mild blood pressure elevation take medicine. But in Europe, an expert committee with access to the same scientific data set different guidelines that don't advise treatment for mild elevation of blood pressure. In Europe, people with the same symptoms would not be encouraged to take medicine. Different groups of experts can disagree significantly about what is "best practice."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) aware(인지하는), (B) different(다른), (C) mild(약한) — 원문 일치
det.analysis:
✅ ① aware — different — mild: 원문 그대로
❌ ② ignorant — different — mild: ignorant는 aware의 반의어
❌ ③ aware — identical — mild: identical은 different의 반의어
❌ ④ aware — different — severe: severe는 mild의 반의어

questions.passage: Patients should be aware that experts often disagree about who should be treated for various conditions. The group of American experts believed that for mild elevation of blood pressure the benefits (A)[exceeded / fell short of] the risks from treatment. They wrote guidelines (B)[suggesting / forbidding] that patients with mild blood pressure elevation (C)[take / avoid] medicine. ❌ ① fell short of — suggesting — take: fell short of는 exceeded의 반의 뉘앙스
✅ ② exceeded — suggesting — take: 원문 그대로
❌ ③ exceeded — forbidding — take: forbidding은 suggesting의 반의어
❌ ④ exceeded — suggesting — avoid: avoid는 take의 반의어

The group of American experts believed that for mild elevation of blood pressure the benefits exceeded the risks from treatment. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) same(같은), (B) don't(~하지 않는다), (C) disagree(의견 불일치하다) — 원문 일치

❌ ② same — do — disagree: do는 원문 don't의 반의(긍정)
✅ ③ same — don't — disagree: 원문 그대로
❌ ④ same — don't — agree: agree는 disagree의 반의어

det.korean: ④ fell short of(미치지 못했다)는 원문 exceeded(초과했다)의 반의 — benefits가 risks보다 크다는 맥락과 불일치

✅ ① aware: 원문 일치

❌ ④ fell short of: 원문 exceeded, benefits exceed risks가 핵심 근거

❌ ① identical: 원문 different, 미국·유럽 지침이 다르다는 핵심과 정반대
✅ ② mild: 원문 일치
✅ ③ medicine: 원문 일치

det.korean: ③ barely(거의 ~ 않게)는 원문 significantly(상당히)의 반의어 — 전문가 집단이 '상당히' 의견이 갈린다는 본문의 강조와 정반대
det.analysis:
✅ ① benefits: 원문 일치
✅ ② scientific: 원문 일치
❌ ③ barely: 원문 significantly, 의견 차가 거의 없다는 의미가 되어 본문 강조와 반대
✅ ④ disagree: 원문 일치

det.korean: (A) set = 수립하다(가이드라인을 정하다), (B) set = 놓다(물건을 두다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: best practice(모범 관행) — 전문가들이 '최선의 관행'이 무엇인지에 대해 의견이 갈린다는 본문의 결론

❌ ③ scientific data: 자료는 공유되고 있어 빈칸 문맥과 불일치

det.korean: with access to the same scientific data(동일한 과학 자료에 접근) — 같은 자료를 가지고도 다른 지침이 나왔다는 본문의 아이러니

❌ ① without guidelines from expert committees: 유럽도 committees가 guidelines를 설정했다는 본문과 상충
❌ ② unaware of the risks from treatment: 유럽 위원회는 위험을 인지하고 다른 결론 도출
✅ ③ with access to the same scientific data: 원문 일치, 같은 데이터·다른 결론 강조
❌ ④ opposed to any suggestions from America: '반대'의 감정적 대립이 아닌 독립적 판단이 본문의 요지
det.tip: access to the same scientific data → still set different guidelines
